_comment: Starting knob values for the Plan 3b recalibration (`pnpm calibrate --from data/params/calibration-start.json --matches 12 --rounds 1 --out out/calib-1.json`, then two more chunks): a first Plan 3b tuning run from the Plan 2c calibration with the pitch-control knobs (pass_pc_weight 0.4, pass_safety 2; loss 5.04, completion still 74 %), plus the pass_arrive knob at 9 m/s, which lets passes beat interceptions. This is the historical Plan 3b starting point; it no longer reproduces data/params/touchline-params.json. The current parameters (Plan 6a, loss 21.45) come from `pnpm calibrate --from data/params/touchline-params.json --out data/params/touchline-params.json --matches 12 --rounds 2`, run from the parameters committed in 06b48a7 on the engine of 26271c6; tuning is deterministic.
